# Research Areas

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🌿 Virome Ecology

Understanding the ecological roles of viruses across natural and agricultural systems.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🦠 Plant Virology

Discovering and characterizing plant viruses using genomics and molecular biology.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🧬 Bioinformatics

Developing computational tools and reproducible workflows for genomic analysis.

:::

::::

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🌎 Disease Ecology

Exploring pathogen dynamics across hosts, landscapes, and ecosystems.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🌱 Microbiome Ecology

Investigating interactions among viruses, fungi, bacteria, oomycetes, nematodes, and plants.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🌲 Forest Pathology

Understanding emerging diseases affecting forest ecosystems.

:::
